overview.description: The Dimensional US Sustainability Core 1 ETF (DFSU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that aims to invest in a portfolio of US equities across all market-caps with perceived high profitability and positive sustainability characteristics. DFSU was launched on Nov 1, 2022 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DFSU is an equity ETF with a total of 1988 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.17%, Apple at 6.53%, Meta Platforms at 3.35%, Microsoft at 3.29%, and Alphabet at 3.19%.
